description.narrative: India has an estimated 69 million white collar working professionals and this number is expected to grow into more than 100 million professionals. Conventional recruitment platforms and service providers prioritise past credentials of each candidate over and above their actual skills and aspirations, often resulting in young professionals being disadvantaged by the current recruitment systems, leading to economic and social negative impact, limited upward mobility and often mismatches between candidates and companies. Recruiters need more effective ways to source and shortlist candidates to better meet the needs of their clients. Soulskill.com, a Dutch-Indian content recruitment platform, offers a solution that addresses these issues with the potential to positively impact both young job seekers and employers, in particular for matching freelance content creators with start-ups and SMEs in the media and eCommerce industry. To prepare for future investments in India, Technical Assistance (DGGF-TA) provided support to Soulskill.com and its subsidiary Corecred Technologies to test the commercial viability of the Soulskill platform with actual users & clients across India (with a focus on the metro cities of Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore). The project included testing the platform 15,000+ test users, both job seekers and employees, finding paying clients and develop a bankable business plan for further investments. The project was successful and supported 10 direct jobs, 35 indirect jobs, trained 5 people regarding software engineering and has led to a validated business plan. Furthermore, it resulted in 5 paying clients in India, including leading consumer media platforms. Further investments are currently being prepared and may result in 25+ paying jobs and 1,000+ indirect jobs (for freelance content creators), over the next 2 years.
